description: Managing the program of the runIT VM: loading objects and blocks, controlling the run (start, pause, step) and subscribing to telemetry.

commands.label: Reset the VM program
commands.description: Removes the loaded program and leaves the VM stopped.

commands.label: Open a program load session
commands.description: Reserves memory for the objects, accessors and blocks of a program, of the given arena size.

fields.label: Number of objects
fields.description: Number of slots for data objects

fields.label: Number of accessors
fields.description: Number of slots for indexing accessors

fields.label: Number of blocks
fields.description: Number of slots for function blocks

fields.label: Memory arena size
fields.description: Total memory reserved for the program

commands.label: Add data objects
commands.description: Registers the definitions of the program's variable and constant objects.

fields.label: Object data
fields.description: Sequence of object records (runs to the end of the frame)

commands.label: Set data values
commands.description: Loads the initial values of objects (while loading) or changes values at run time.

fields.label: Value data
fields.description: Sequence of value records (runs to the end of the frame)

commands.label: Add accessors
commands.description: Defines the access and indexing paths into the structures and arrays of the program.

fields.label: Accessor data
fields.description: Sequence of accessor records (runs to the end of the frame)

commands.label: Add a block
commands.description: Loads one block, in the order the control loop runs them.

fields.label: Block definition
fields.description: Block header, pins and state (runs to the end of the frame)

commands.label: Telemetry subscription
commands.description: Chooses the objects whose values are streamed to the app as telemetry (an empty list clears the subscription).

fields.label: List of object IDs
fields.description: Sequence of subscription records (runs to the end of the frame)

commands.label: Control the run of the program
commands.description: Starts, pauses, resumes, steps or resets the VM program.

commands.label: Slow motion
commands.description: Slows down the passes of the VM program for debugging live.

fields.label: Slow-down factor
fields.description: 1 = normal speed, more than 1 = slow motion

fields.label: Time per step
fields.description: Program time each pass you ask for adds while the VM is stepped (scan or block mode), so TIMER, PERIODIC and Every go on; 0 stands time still

commands.label: Read the state of the VM
commands.description: Returns whether the program runs (the run mode), whether one is loaded and complete, the latched device fault and the pass statistics.

returns.description: What the VM is doing and what it holds

fields.label: Run mode
fields.description: Stopped, running, paused (frozen), or a debugging mode

fields.label: Program ready
fields.description: A program is loaded and complete: EXEC can start it

fields.label: Fault latched
fields.description: A critical device fault stops the VM until EXEC Ack fault

fields.label: Device of the fault
fields.description: Meaningful only while a fault is latched

fields.label: Root cause of the fault
fields.description: The error tag at the root of the latched fault (0 if not known); meaningful only while a fault is latched

fields.label: Passes
fields.description: Passes completed since the statistics were reset

fields.label: Next block
fields.description: The block the next Next runs while the VM is stepped by block: the one it is parked before, or 0 between two passes (0xFFFF otherwise)
